head: 89de9af4b631abdef5673ce8949fb02a32f6fcad + archived workspace
implementationMapping: R07.12 explicitly permits equivalent non-CRDT implementation. Append maps to versioned Worker edits; materialize to authoritative OOXML snapshots; subscription to production native watch and snapshot fallback. This does not claim a CRDT protocol.
defectAndFix: A transient recovery-checkpoint IO failure had no 1000ms retry. Add exactly one retry for the same draft/version checkpoint; new edits supersede the timer and close/discard/save cancel it. CHANGED/TOO_LARGE/CONFLICT/UNTRUSTED/TIMEOUT and source-write failures never enter this retry. No edit or source-save replay is introduced.

branches.branch: checkpoint pre-write IO and lost durable receipt
branches.result: At 999ms no retry; at 1000ms same payload is retried once. Independent recovery-envelope decode retains raw input. Source is unchanged until explicit save; exactly one native source write.
Inject first RPC failure before edit; real durable raw pending input retained, model remains version 0, 30s no replay. Explicit retry applies once and writes once.
Actual packaged Worker receives an obsolete expected version and rejects CHANGED. Model/draft retained, source unchanged, no automatic source retry. Explicit valid-version retry succeeds.

TOO_LARGE explicitly injected at parser materialize boundary; valid current draft/model retained, source untouched and no retry loop. Removing the injected failure permits explicit save. This tests error handling, not generating a >40MiB edited workbook.
Real external XLSX modification creates a conflict receipt. External bytes, local Worker model and draft are retained; source is not overwritten.

Real native subscription receives one injected disconnect callback; production fallback announces poll/resync and broker snapshot detects a real external XLSX change. Explicit renderer refresh retains dirty input and conflict. Lease revocation announces none/source-invalid, retains checkpointable model and releases all watch resources.

Unit matrix proves bounded IO retry, zero retry for non-IO problems, retained pending input and busy=false. Closing cancels retry. DEV055 packaged real permission test proves source autosave remains paused across 60s and new input, then explicit recovery writes once.

retainedFailures: First matrix assertions incorrectly looked for host save-error strip inside the Office grid component; the actual strip lives in workspace-panel.tsx. Corrected the component-boundary assertion without changing production error display.
Sandbox matrix r1/r2 native watcher did not reach native coverage. Identical test passed in normal macOS environment (r3) and against r9 packaged Worker/native helpers.
Tree B07 initial test expected undefined for a closed active tab; production API returns null. Corrected assertion; four tree tests passed.
Initial package command included an extra --, failed at argument parsing before any build. Corrected command completed normally.

aggregateLatestCodeResults.basis: Previous full baseline plus targeted reruns, deduplicated by file/full test name; not a new monolithic full-suite run.

boundaries: Original J08 requires U+I, now complete. It has no A/P requirement; no App GUI or visual/IME acceptance is claimed.
Tests use production renderer buffers/service orchestration plus actual packaged Worker/native broker, with explicitly listed fault injection.
R9 replaces the candidate package, but the older running GUI was not stopped/replaced while user is away.
This does not complete the milestone or authorize a release.
